properties.description: Forged in Fire (premiered 2015) is an American reality competition series that pits bladesmiths against each other in timed, judged challenges. The show stars Doug Marcaida, David Lain Baker and Ben Abbott among its regular contributors, and blends technical demonstration of forging with expert critique and elimination. Episodes focus on materials, technique and finishing, culminating in practical and destructive tests to assess performance. The series highlights themes of craftsmanship, tradition, technical mastery and camaraderie while maintaining a tense, competitive tone.
properties.plot_summary: Four bladesmiths face a sequence of timed, judged challenges to design, forge and finish usable knives. Each episode tests materials selection, forging technique and finishing under pressure, with experts inspecting construction and performance. Contestants’ work is evaluated through practical and destructive testing to determine which blade best meets the criteria. The format blends technical craft demonstration with competitive elimination and expert critique.
properties.audience_identity: Viewers are typically hands-on, craft-appreciative adults who value technical skill, historical weaponry and do-it-yourself mastery, and who enjoy watching expert judgment applied to tangible, physical work.
properties.genre_description: A nonfiction reality competition format that stages timed, judged challenges where contestants demonstrate specialized practical skills for elimination and reward.
properties.style_description: Direct, documentary-style cinematography emphasizes close-up views of metalworking, tools, heat and texture, pairing observational footage with dynamic action shots of forging and testing.

short_descriptions.value: Bladesmiths compete in timed forging challenges to produce usable knives judged by experts through construction and performance tests.
Schmiede treten in zeitlich begrenzten Herausforderungen gegeneinander an, um brauchbare Klingen zu schmieden, die von Experten geprüft werden.
Forjadores compiten en retos cronometrados para crear y probar cuchillos utilizables que son evaluados por expertos.
Des forgerons s'affrontent dans des épreuves chronométrées pour fabriquer et tester des lames jugées par des experts.

properties.situational_contexts: People often watch during relaxed evenings or as light, inspiring viewing while working on hobbies, seeking practical ideas, skill inspiration, or competitive entertainment to wind down with friends or family.
properties.plot_themes_description: The series explores the value of hands-on craftsmanship, the drive for technical mastery, traditions of metalwork, competitive evaluation, and the bonds formed among practitioners.
properties.emotional_tone_description: Exciting and focused, the show evokes admiration for skilled manual labor while keeping viewers on edge as contestants race to meet exacting standards under pressure.

properties.description: Intelligence (2020) is a British workplace sitcom starring David Schwimmer, Nick Mohammed and Jane Stanness that follows an unlikely cyber-crime unit based at GCHQ. The series pairs an insecure American NSA agent with an eccentric British computer analyst, producing sketch-like, offbeat workplace episodes that blend absurd humor with character-driven moments. The show emphasizes eccentric, brilliant staff and explores themes of cultural clash, friendship, and the human side of surveillance work. Overall, it combines deadpan and physical comedy with occasional heartfelt beats.
properties.plot_summary: An insecure American NSA agent is assigned to join forces with an eccentric British computer analyst to form a cyber-crime unit housed inside GCHQ. Their mismatched partnership sparks a series of sketch-like, offbeat workplace episodes that blend absurdist jokes with character-based comedy. The show highlights the quirks of highly gifted but socially awkward tech staff as personal dynamics and office politics collide with surveillance-era responsibilities. Beneath the laughs there are moments of warmth and surprising emotional grounding between the leads and their colleagues.
properties.audience_identity: People who appreciate offbeat, character-driven workplace comedy with deadpan and absurdist humor, often valuing quirky performances, tech-adjacent satire, and warm interpersonal dynamics.
properties.genre_description: An episodic workplace sitcom that blends sketch-like humor and situational comedy with character-focused, observational storytelling set in a government tech office.
properties.style_description: A playful, slightly stylized visual approach that uses sketch-like vignettes and deadpan performances to create a bright, observational comic tone.

short_descriptions.value: An insecure American NSA agent pairs with an eccentric British analyst to run a cybercrime unit at GCHQ, producing offbeat workplace chaos.
Ein unsicherer US-Agent bildet mit einem exzentrischen britischen Analysten ein Team bei GCHQ zur Bekämpfung von Cyberkriminalität, was zu schrulligem Bürowahnsinn führt.
Un agente estadounidense inseguro se une a un analista británico excéntrico para dirigir una unidad de ciberdelitos en GCHQ, provocando caos laboral excéntrico.
Un agent américain peu sûr de lui s'associe à un analyste britannique excentrique pour diriger une unité cyber à GCHQ, provoquant un chaos de bureau décalé.

properties.situational_contexts: Watched as light evening entertainment, social viewing with friends, or binge sessions when seeking short, laugh-driven episodes that reward appreciation of British comedic sensibilities.
properties.plot_themes_description: The series explores mismatched partnerships and workplace dynamics within a tech-surveillance setting, using cultural clashes and eccentric personalities to examine friendship and belonging.
properties.emotional_tone_description: Playfully awkward and affectionate, combining deadpan, offbeat comedy with moments of genuine warmth and character vulnerability.

properties.description: The Great Pottery Throw Down (released 2020-09-17) is a reality game-show that follows a group of home potters as they compete in studio challenges judged by pottery experts. Featuring judges and experts such as Keith Brymer Jones, Richard Miller and Rose Schmits, the series foregrounds technical skills like wheel-throwing, handbuilding and glazing while maintaining a supportive, instructive tone. The show balances competitive format elements with documentary-style moments that highlight creativity, mentorship and community, producing a calm, heartwarming viewing experience.
properties.plot_summary: Ten home potters travel to Stoke-on-Trent to compete in a series of studio challenges that test wheel-throwing, handbuilding, decoration and glazing. Each week contestants produce technical and creative pieces under time and material constraints while being observed and judged by pottery experts. The atmosphere emphasizes craft, learning and mutual support more than manufactured conflict, with judges offering constructive feedback and contestants often helping one another.
properties.audience_identity: People who value handmade skill and gentle competition, enjoy learning craft techniques, and prefer warm, community-minded entertainment over confrontational reality TV.
properties.genre_description: A reality competition series that stages skills-based challenges in the applied arts, pairing timed, judged contests with documentary-style coverage of makers and their processes.
properties.style_description: Shot in a naturalistic, observational manner with warm lighting and close-up details of hands, clay and kilns, the visual style emphasizes texture and the craft process.

short_descriptions.value: Amateur potters compete in studio challenges to prove their skills and win the title of Top Potter.
Hobby-Töpfer treten in Werkstattaufgaben gegeneinander an, zeigen ihr Können und kämpfen um den Titel Top Potter.
Alfareros aficionados compiten en retos de taller para demostrar su habilidad y ganar el título de Top Potter.
Des potiers amateurs s'affrontent dans des épreuves d'atelier pour montrer leur savoir‑faire et remporter le titre de Top Potter.

production_companies: Department for Culture, Media and Sport
properties.situational_contexts: Enjoyed during relaxed evenings, weekend leisure time, or while practicing crafts, often watched by viewers seeking calming, instructional entertainment or inspiration for DIY projects.
properties.plot_themes_description: The series explores the value of craftsmanship and creative growth within a community of makers, balancing personal improvement with friendly competition and mentorship.
properties.emotional_tone_description: Calm, uplifting and warm, the show celebrates skill and creativity while fostering a supportive, feel-good atmosphere.

properties.description: Downward Dog (2017) is a single-camera dramedy created by Samm Hodges and Michael Killen and showrun by Kat Likkel and John Hoberg. Starring Allison Tolman, Samm Hodges (voice), and Lucas Neff, it follows a philosophically minded dog who narrates domestic life as his owner copes with an on-again/off-again relationship and career uncertainty. The series blends observational humor with existential, character-driven drama to explore companionship, loneliness, and personal growth. Its tone is warm, bittersweet, and quietly poignant.
properties.plot_summary: A lonely, philosophical dog narrates life with his owner, observing her messy on-again/off-again relationship and career struggles. Through his candid voiceover he translates ordinary domestic moments into wry, often existential reflections on love, loyalty, and loneliness. The series alternates gentle humor with poignant emotional beats as both dog and owner reveal personal growth. It treats the animal perspective as a lens on human relationships rather than a gimmick.
properties.audience_identity: Empathetic, reflective adults—often pet lovers—who favor intimate, character-driven storytelling and bittersweet humor that combines emotional honesty with restrained comedy.
properties.genre_description: A single-camera dramedy that pairs gentle observational comedy with emotional, character-focused drama, using introspective voiceover and domestic realism.
properties.style_description: Warm, naturalistic single-camera visuals with muted domestic palettes, intimate observational staging, and photoreal visual effects for the dog to create a quietly surreal, confessional feel.

short_descriptions.value: A lonely dog navigates the complexity of 21st century relationships.
Ein einsamer Hund navigiert durch die Komplexität zwischenmenschlicher Beziehungen im 21. Jahrhundert.
Un perro solitario navega la complejidad de las relaciones del siglo XXI.
Un chien solitaire navigue dans la complexité des relations du XXIe siècle.

properties.situational_contexts: Viewed during quiet evenings or low-key moments when audiences want gentle humor with emotional depth, often as a winding-down show or while relaxing with a pet.
properties.plot_themes_description: Uses an introspective animal narrator to examine loneliness, the uncertainty of modern romantic life, and the ways companionship shapes identity and personal growth.
properties.emotional_tone_description: Warm, bittersweet, and gently funny, the series balances wistful melancholy with affectionate humor to leave viewers both amused and moved.

entities.name: Who Do You Think You Are?

akas.value: "フー・ドゥ・ユー・シンク・ユー・アー?"

properties.description: Who Do You Think You Are? (first broadcast 2004) is a British documentary and biography series that follows celebrities as they research their family histories. Featuring contributors such as Mark Strong, Phil Davis, and Cherie Lunghi among many others, each episode reconstructs ancestors' lives using archives and expert research to connect personal discoveries to wider historical events. The show blends informative historical context with intimate, emotional storytelling to explore themes of identity, migration, memory, and legacy.
properties.plot_summary: A genealogy documentary that follows public figures as they trace their family trees using archival records, oral histories, and on-location research. Each episode reconstructs ancestors' lives through birth, marriage, census, property, court, and military records, uncovering surprising or previously unknown facts. The investigations often reveal connections to larger historical events—migration, war, persecution—and produce emotional reactions as participants confront personal and social histories. The tone mixes informative historical context with intimate, human storytelling.

properties.audience_identity: People who are curious and historically minded—often empathetic, research-oriented individuals who value personal roots, social context, and emotionally rich, evidence-based storytelling.
properties.genre_description: A biographical documentary format that uses genealogical research and archival material to produce intimate, history-focused portraits of public figures.
properties.style_description: The series favors intimate, observational cinematography and archival material, combining interviews, on-location research, and historical documents to build an emotionally resonant, evidence-led narrative.

short_descriptions.value: Celebrities explore their family trees through archival research, uncovering surprising and often emotional revelations about their ancestors.
Prominente erforschen ihre Familiengeschichte in Archiven und Recherchen und entdecken überraschende, oft emotionale Enthüllungen über ihre Vorfahren.
Celebridades investigan su árbol genealógico mediante archivos y pesquisas, descubriendo revelaciones sorprendentes y a menudo emotivas sobre sus antepasados.
Des célébrités explorent leur arbre généalogique via archives et recherches, découvrant des révélations surprenantes et souvent émouvantes sur leurs ancêtres.

properties.situational_contexts: Viewed during quiet, reflective moments, family gatherings, or research sessions when people are exploring ancestry, learning social history, or seeking emotionally resonant human stories.

properties.plot_themes_description: By tracing individual lineages the series explores how family history, migration, conflict, and social conditions shape personal identity and collective memory.
properties.emotional_tone_description: Poignant and intimate, the series blends curiosity and empathy as participants react emotionally to unexpected personal and historical discoveries.
